name: San Diego
living: sunset light glitters and ripples across the bay (a slow scrolling sparkle on the painted water)
little sailboats drift slowly across the bay
palm fronds sway gently in the sea breeze
orange and pink pixel clouds drift slowly across the sunset (sky layer drift)
warm windows light up one by one in the brick warehouse and the downtown towers
a few seagulls glide across the sky now and then
fans on the warehouse balconies shimmer and wave
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe softly
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
